texts.zh:
[from.GetName]上极端热信号的源头找到了。

遍布行星的间歇泉从地表深处释放出高度易燃的氢气。这些间歇泉喷发时，气体就被行星的热量点燃，产生直抵云霄的巨大火柱。

再和大气压力相结合，就产生了极不稳定的气流，以巨大的火焰龙卷风的形式横扫地面。

尽管这是一种极具破坏力的自然现象，但我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower]很确信这些龙卷风以及其产生的大量动能可以人为地复现并加以利用。
texts.en:
The source of the extreme heat signatures on [from.GetName] has been discovered.

Across the planet, geysers are emitting highly flammable hydrogen gas from deep below the surface. As these geysers erupt, the planet's heat ignites the gas, resulting in vast pillars of flame blasting into the skies.

When combined with the atmospheric pressure, this creates extremely volatile air currents, sending streams of fire swirling across the landscape in the form of massive, flaming tornadoes.

While a devastating natural phenomena, our [Root.Owner.GetResearcherPlural_lower] are confident that these tornadoes, and the vast volumes of kinetic energy they generate, could be recreated artificially for practical use.

texts.zh:
[from.Leader.GetName]发现了在可控环境中再现并驾驭[from.From.GetName]上发现的那种火龙卷的方法。

有了这一突破，我们就能够利用的恒星基地来增加在同一星系中发现的所有熔融星球所产出的能量。
texts.en:
[from.Leader.GetName] has successfully found a way to recreate and harness the flaming tornadoes found on [from.From.GetName] in a controlled environment.

With this breakthrough, we will be able to use our starbases to increase the energy produced by any molten worlds that are found in the same system.

texts.zh: 这项科学理论与我们目前对电弧熔炉的理解有许多异曲同工之处，打开了域外建筑学领域的许多全新可能。
texts.en: The scientific theory shares many parallels with our existing understanding of Arc Furnaces, opening new possibilities for offworld construction.

texts.zh: 这一发现背后的科学理论在电弧熔炉的研发中有诸多应用，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经开始将它们应用在实际开发当中。
texts.en: The scientific theory behind this discovery has various applications towards the development of Arc Furnace technology, with our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] prepared to start applying the theory in practical development.

texts.zh: 通过对[from.GetName]上火龙卷的形成条件更密切的研究，就可以在受控环境中得以复现这种现象好的一面。
texts.en: By studying the conditions behind the flaming tornadoes of [from.GetName] more closely, the benefits of this phenomena could be recreated in a controlled environment.
